notes: Frozen before extracting new model features. Whole paired scenarios and exact duplicate videos share a split; duplicates are not sampled.
Rows are zero-based references to manifest annotation.rows, copied with text and original bounds into the prepared manifest.
Only observable actions are labeled. Violation/clean status and law identifiers are not classifier targets or features.

Machine is a broad operation episode, including loading, unloading and watching a running machine. Safe combines opening, closing, locking and storage; it does not certify cash custody. Document combines receiving and inspecting; it does not certify identity verification.
Long mixed rows such as X-4 laptop-and-cash, X-14 repeated unpack/count/sort and X-38 initial handover-and-machine are excluded. Unmapped, ambiguous and short intervals are unscored, not negatives.
Annotations are coarse episode labels, not frame-perfect action boundaries. Selected intervals have a 0.125-second inward margin; this does not remove all boundary noise.
Same 16 source frames per 2-second window and same whole-frame aspect-preserving padding to 224 square for both models. Native model normalization differs. Fine objects may be too small.

Fixed C grid selected on validation macro F1. Test labels are used only for final scoring, never model selection. No refit on validation after selection. Class-balanced logistic regression, L2-normalized vectors, no learned feature scaling.

This is a new split for action-head fitting on a previously inspected dataset. It is not a pristine external test or a test of unseen cameras/violations. Adjacent windows within a partition remain correlated.
